Subject: DPA execution logistics and signatory authority

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for getting the updated DPA to us. Procurement has a couple of execution questions before we move to signature:

- FinPay requires the signing envelope to capture a signatory authority declaration (name/title + badge number optional). Can Redwood's AdobeSign template collect an explicit "authorized signer" checkbox and a free-text title field?
- We have two authorized signers on our side (Oliver Grant and Sara Liu). Both need to sign, but we also need a countersign from an exec on Redwood's side (VP-level or above). Can you confirm routing order so both of our signers do not need to sign twice?
- Do you support an optional witness field (name + email) we can include for jurisdictional compliance? If witness is present, it should not block automated countersign routing.

We typically use AdobeSign for procurement, but if Redwood prefers DocuSign as a fallback we can accept that; just let us know envelope links and expected sign-completion ETA.

I attached the DPA with our 3 small redlines (look for highlighted comments). If we can get this live by Friday, that would help our onboarding timeline.

Best,
Oliver
Director, Procurement
FinPay

Oliver — thanks, got the redlines and good questions. Looping in Marissa (Legal) and Karthik (Platform ops) to confirm the envelope setup and signer matrix. Quick answers up front:

- Yes, our AdobeSign templates can include a required "Authorized signer" checkbox and a free-text Title/Department field. We can also add an optional witness name/email text field that is not gating.
- We recommend routing order: FinPay signer 1 -> FinPay signer 2 (parallel routing between your two signers) -> Redwood exec (countersign). That avoids duplicate signing and preserves an audit trail.
- If witness is supplied, it will be included as a supplemental recipient (no action required by Redwood to countersign).

Marissa — can you confirm Legal's sign-off on the redlines so Karthik can prepare the envelope? If Legal needs to countersign with a different person depending on value/term changes, please indicate the fallback signer and any delegation rules.

Oliver — once Marissa OKs we will send an AdobeSign envelope and paste the link in this thread. ETA: same day if we get sign-off this afternoon; otherwise Friday morning.

Thanks,
Rachel
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks Rachel. I reviewed Oliver's redlines — two commercial clarifications (retention narrowness + subprocessor list) and one minor execution item (signature block formatting). Legal is comfortable with the substance of the redlines; we will accept their edits with one condition:

- We need the DPA to be countersigned by a Redwood Officer (Head of Legal or VP of Revenue). I can countersign on behalf of Legal, but for contracts above our $X threshold the countersign must be the Head of Legal or CRO. If FinPay confirms the contract value falls under that threshold, I will countersign.

Routing preferences: AdobeSign is preferred by FinPay; that's fine with us. Two operational notes for Karthik:

1) Envelope should set the "Signer Role" for Redwood as "Redwood Countersignatory - Marissa Cole" and include conditional delegation to "Head of Legal" if Marissa delegates. Please add a delegation note in the envelope metadata.
2) Add an internal-only audit marker field (checkbox) "Reviewed by Legal" that gets auto-checked when the envelope lands in our countersign queue. This helps compliance.

Karthik: if you can draft the envelope with the fields Rachel outlined, include me as the countersigner and set the fallback to Head of Legal. Oliver, once we send you'll receive an AdobeSign link and a status webhook to the procurement inbox.

Marissa
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

All — I configured the AdobeSign envelope per the spec below and queued it for dispatch at 15:00 PT today. Summary of envelope setup and routing (screenshot attached):

- Document: "Redwood_FinPay_DPA_v3_final.pdf" (includes Marissa's countersign block).
- Recipients and routing:
  1) FinPay Signer A: Oliver Grant — role: "FinPay Authorized Signer" (required)
  2) FinPay Signer B: Sara Liu — role: "FinPay Authorized Signer" (required) (parallel routing with Signer A)
  3) Redwood Countersign: Marissa Cole — role: "Redwood Countersignatory" (required)
  4) Internal Audit (optional): "Witness" (text field + email) inserted as supplemental recipient (non-blocking).

- Fields included: authorized-signer checkbox, signer title free-text, witness name/email (optional), internal-only "Reviewed by Legal" checkbox (auto-checked on arrival to countersign queue).
- Delegation: Marissa can delegate to "Head of Legal" using AdobeSign's "assign to" function; the envelope metadata includes a delegation note.
- Webhooks & status: Envelope link: https://adobesign.example.com/envelope/ABC12345 (live after dispatch). We enabled status webhooks to procurement@finpay.com and our internal contracts webhook (https://hooks.redwood.internal/contracts/status).
- Fallback: If AdobeSign fails, we will fall back to a DocuSign envelope with identical fields; DocuSign draft will be created automatically and linked in the envelope metadata (DocuSign draft id: DS-99842).

Oliver/Sara — expect the AdobeSign email with a "Sign Document" button. Let us know if you need the envelope split (one signer per envelope) but that will slow the audit chain. ETA for completion: with two signers + countersign, typically same-day to 48 hours depending on signer availability.
